diagnostic_slices.case_type: Group queries by frozen retrieval_query.case_type and aggregate the ordinary full-qrel metrics within each group.
diagnostic_slices.document_kind: For each kind POLICY and FAQ, include queries having at least one eligible judged document of that kind with relevance >= 1, then aggregate the ordinary full-qrel metrics on that query subset.
diagnostic_slices.conflict_fixture: Include queries having at least one eligible judged conflict-fixture document with relevance >= 1, then aggregate the ordinary full-qrel metrics on that query subset.
diagnostic_slices.untrusted_content_fixture: Include queries having at least one eligible judged untrusted-content-fixture document with relevance >= 1, then aggregate the ordinary full-qrel metrics on that query subset.
diagnostic_slices.selection_use: Diagnostic slices are descriptive only and cannot change H1, H2, or the complexity-selection decision.

hypothesis_verdicts.supported: point estimate > 0 and lower 95% percentile bound > 0
hypothesis_verdicts.adverse: point estimate < 0 and upper 95% percentile bound < 0

complexity_selection_operationalization.comparison_basis: candidate versus current winner at that step
complexity_selection_operationalization.final_tie_rule: Among candidates that earned adoption, if aggregate nDCG@10 values are within 0.005 of the best accepted value, select the lower-p95 candidate; if still tied, select the lower-numbered candidate. If none earns adoption, retain B0.

immutability.workflow_trigger: one automatic push-to-main execution when the R3.2 workflow file is first merged
